title: 🏦 100% Insurance FDI Operationalisation — Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act 2025
executiveSummary: DPIIT notified 100% FDI under automatic route for insurance companies under Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act 2025 effective Feb 5, mandating at least 1 resident Indian CEO/MD/Chair.
